in_marathi.name: Dhanashree
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanashree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanashree is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘dhanam’ which means wealth and ‘shree’ which means tree or prosperity. This name signifies a person who is wealthy and flourishing in all aspects of life. It is also believed to bring prosperity and success to the bearer.
